nodes.label: Registry-Dict over If/Elif Principle
nodes.rationale: Codebase self-invented convention: dispatch on config value should use a name->builder callable dict (as in provider_factory.py _PROVIDER_BUILDERS, model_catalog.py EMBEDDING_CATALOG/RERANKER_CATALOG) rather than an if/elif chain, so new providers/parsers/retrievers/rerankers are added without touching branching logic; parser_registry.py build_node_parser() and retriever.py build_retriever() are legacy if/elif debt, not the model to copy.

nodes.label: No Hardcoded OpenRouter Provider Assumptions Principle
nodes.rationale: Every model/provider selection must resolve through model_catalog or provider_factory.required_env_var(), never a literal env.get('OPENROUTER_API_KEY') or hardcoded 'if x == CohereRerank' check, because this exact bug class (hand-maintained provider assumption going stale when a second provider is added) has recurred in ragas_setup.py (fixed), retriever.py _build_query_fusion_llm() (not fixed), and validator.py's CohereRerank/OPENROUTER_API_KEY check (not fixed).
nodes.norm_label: no hardcoded openrouter provider assumptions principle

nodes.label: Derive Validation Allowlists From Pydantic Model Fields Principle
nodes.rationale: config/loader.py's load_settings() now derives valid keys via set(SearchSpaceSettings.model_fields) after allowed_embedding_models silently drifted out of a hand-maintained valid_search_keys set; future key-validation code must derive its allowlist from the model, not retype it.
nodes.norm_label: derive validation allowlists from pydantic model fields principle

nodes.label: Constructor-Injected Dependencies over Module Singletons Principle
nodes.rationale: cost_tracker.py's _default_tracker and openrouter.py's _default_client are legacy singletons kept only for backward compatibility; new code should accept Provider/cost_tracker/env as constructor parameters, matching OpenAIClient's design rather than OpenRouterClient's dual-mode injected-or-global-fallback design.
nodes.norm_label: constructor-injected dependencies over module singletons principle
nodes.community_name: Constructor-Injected Dependencies over Module Singletons Principle

nodes.label: Repository Pattern for Persistence Principle
nodes.rationale: New SQL/persistence logic belongs in a repository class under src/storage/repositories/, not inline in orchestrator/scientist nodes, to keep persistence concerns separated from orchestration logic.

nodes.label: Protocol Convergence Before Third Implementation Principle
nodes.rationale: Before writing a third ILLMClient-like implementation, check whether OpenRouterClient and OpenAIClient have converged enough (retry/backoff shape, RETRYABLE_STATUS_CODES split, fallback-model-on-rate-limit, injected-cost-tracker-with-singleton-fallback are duplicated between them today) to be worth factoring into a shared ~250-line base rather than copy-pasting a third client.
